name: team_audit
title: Flowork Specialist Auditor Council
description: Requests an adversarial, multi-dimensional audit from the Specialist Auditor Council (Security Specialist, Logic & QA Specialist, Architecture & Standards Specialist). Audits specified target files or git diff changes, evaluates Fowler code smells, detects secret/path leaks, verifies @lock sanctity, checks error handling, and returns an authoritative Council Verdict (PASS/REJECT with score 0-100) and actionable remediations.
author: Flowork Sovereign Core

target_files.description: Optional list of file paths to audit. If omitted or empty, automatically audits all modified and uncommitted git workspace files.

audit_scope.description: Scope of the audit: 'full' (all specialists), 'security' (SAST, secrets, leaks), 'logic' (error handling, panic risks, boundary conditions), or 'architecture' (code smells, @lock sanctity, nano-modular). Defaults to 'full'.

context.description: Optional background context or feature intent explaining the changes to help the auditor council focus their review.

strict_mode.description: If true, treats code smells or moderate warnings as audit score deductions. Defaults to true.

reason.description: MANDATORY ON EVERY TOOL CALL: Clear, concise technical rationale explaining WHY you are calling this tool right now.
